name: Collar and trunk-base observation
whereToLook: Root collar, trunk base, basin, and canopy.
visibility: Record bark condition, gum or moisture, position relative to soil, standing water, and canopy decline. Do not treat any one sign as confirmation.
seasonality: Record recent irrigation, rainfall, drainage, and injury conditions; a reviewed seasonal risk calendar is not yet available.
identificationNotes: Gummosis, foot rot, and collar rot are farmer terms that need a cause-specific diagnosis before a treatment choice.
immediateAction: Improve observation quality and avoid scraping or painting affected bark until the cause is reasonably confirmed.
managementEvidence: Demonstration disease guide: nonchemical drainage and collar-protection context is present; a complete disease treatment dataset is a separate phase.
